'''Hethra Mcgrrrr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who lived during the first years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
He was remembered for founding and leading the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band that engaged in shipjackings and plundering throughout the [[Delphon system/Legends|Delphon system]] during the Clone Wars and the first days of the Empire's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. At some point, Mcgrrrr left the leading seat of the gang, though the circumstances of his departure were likely violent

He was also remembered as the father of [[Opun Mcgrrrr|Opun "Black Hole" Mcgrrrr]], a criminal businessman who rose to prominence during the rise of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
